description: Defines the RecursiveExtensionFilterCallback class used for filtering directories during Drupal extension discovery, with specific logic for skipping certain folders and files.

classes.name: RecursiveExtensionFilterCallback
classes.description: A class that filters directories and files to optimize Drupal extension discovery by skipping irrelevant folders and files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with optional skipped folders and whether to accept test directories.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a given directory or file is acceptable based on its name and path, applying specific rules for extension directories.
